Nita's attack range is only 6 tiles and her mobility is low; on pure open Bounty maps she gets outranged before charging Super, so Bruce pressure only matters when walls, chokepoints, or bushes let her actually reach a grouped lane.

Knockout deaths are permanent and Bruce can be burst down before value; if the enemy has splash/thrower/chain clear, Nita's Super feeds a pick instead of creating a catch window, so she is a late situational pick, not an open-map staple.

zone_sustain_and_cleanse_anchor.objective_conversion: turn health resets into zone time and deny control effects that would normally force a retreat

brawl_ball_tank_push_heal_lane.fails_if: Poco is drafted without a damage carry, enemy knockback isolates the scorer, or the goal remains closed with no wallbreak/control

wide_spread_bush_check_and_retreat_suppo.fails_if: enemy outranges from open lines, burns grass first, or has enough burst to ignore repeated small heals

objective_contracts.false_positive: Poco makes the push live longer; he does not create the goal opening by himself.

needs_teammate_support: tank/body or mid-range damage dealer who can stand on zone

needs_teammate_support: lane pressure that lets Poco hold or approach the safe edge
objective_contracts.false_positive: Healing does not convert into safe damage; Poco's low objective damage loses pure race matchups and PLP does not list Heist as a main mode.

needs_teammate_support: anti-assassin peel while Poco holds mid-range
objective_contracts.false_positive: Wide spread pokes grouped targets, but low damage does not secure kills or stars on open Bounty lanes.

needs_teammate_support: damage carry who converts healed uptime into eliminations
objective_contracts.false_positive: Sustain cannot undo a single burst elimination; round resets shrink heal value if the team loses the damage race.

low_damage_no_carry.mitigation: draft Poco with a frontliner, scorer, or damage carry who converts the health advantage

burst_outpaces_sustain.active_when: enemy focus fire kills the target before Super, Da Capo, or cleanse timing matters

slot_notes.slot_4_5: use to answer revealed status-control drafts or repair a comp that needs sustain, while checking enemy can still last-pick Barley/tank pressure
slot_notes.slot_6: rarely a punish pick by himself; strongest when enemy already over-indexed on poison/slow/stun control and lacks burst through healing

teammate damage once Draco forces defenders to move

anti-CC answer so the 0.5-second Super delay is not canceled

slot_notes.slot_6: best as a last response into control pockets or mobile aggro that must fight Draco in a choke, with Last Stand timing already mapped

Knockout deaths are permanent and Bruce can be burst down before value; if the enemy has splash/thrower/chain clear, Nita's Super feeds a pick instead of creating a catch window, so she is a late situational pick, not an open-map staple.

heist_post_safe_route_loop.objective_conversion: convert the opening charge pool into a bounded safe-damage burst and forced defensive attention

heist_post_safe_route_loop.fails_if: the pool is spent on setup and lane trades before safe contact, the enemy wins faster safe DPS, camps the last Post, or silence/cocoon/CC stops the dash cycle

safe_barrier_wall_bypass_and_route_retar.fails_if: the map opens into long-range DPS after wallbreak, Ghost Train is spent without objective contact, or the endpoint is guarded by anti-aggro

post_rotation_carrier_or_zone_chase.fails_if: charges run out mid-rotation, a goal or round reset removes Posts, the enemy camps the endpoint, or route pressure does not convert into gems or zone time

needs_teammate_support: early lane pressure while Chuck spends charges on Posts
answers to silence, cocoon, knockback, or endpoint campers

needs_teammate_support: mid control that buys time to place route Posts

needs_teammate_support: scorer and wallbreak/control if goal geometry is closed
early lane pressure while Chuck places Posts

needs_teammate_support: marksman or long-range teammate to control open sightlines
lane protection during the setup window

needs_teammate_support: ranged lane teammate to hold space and force predictable routes
bait or ban for Charlie, Otis, Cordelius-style denial before Chuck commits

post_route_predictability.active_when: Chuck repeats the same route and enemies camp the final Post
post_route_predictability.mitigation: use Rerouting to move a Post while refunding 50% of a charge, alternate endpoints, or draft pressure that punishes endpoint campers

super_denial_or_control_interrupt.active_when: enemy can mute, cocoon, knock back, slow, stun, or send Chuck away before dash value converts, wasting charges from a non-refillable pool
super_denial_or_control_interrupt.mitigation: avoid into cheap Super denial or force those tools on a different lane before committing the charge pool

raw_laning_without_posts.active_when: Chuck is forced into standard lane fighting after his charges are spent and no useful post graph remains
raw_laning_without_posts.mitigation: evaluate him by route-to-objective, not by generic lane DPS, and time the charge pool around objective spawns

Belle's long poke helps the mine lane, but her low health and lack of bush tools make her a risky early pick on bush-heavy maps like Hard Rock Mine or Gem Fort.
Belle can pressure lanes and mark a carrier, but she has no scoring tools or escape; on ball routes that force her near the goal she becomes a liability.

jump_score_or_cleanup_window.fails_if: enemy holds knockback/burst, target is behind multiple teammates, or goal geometry remains closed

heist_lane_attrition_not_primary_dps.fails_if: draft expects Crow to be the main safe damage source or enemy wins with longer range/cross-lane DPS

needs_teammate_support: peel after Crow spends Super aggressively
objective_contracts.false_positive: Crow can create or finish a score window; he does not solve closed goals or front-line holding by himself.

needs_teammate_support: lane winner that converts poisoned defenders into safe hits
objective_contracts.false_positive: Heist Crow is a control/defense layer; drafting him as the sole race tool is a trap.

needs_teammate_support: area clear or wallbreak against pocket control
objective_contracts.false_positive: Crow helps win the edge of the zone; he still needs teammates to occupy and clear the circle.

needs_teammate_support: teammate to hold star lead and convert poisoned targets
long-range or wallbreak answer if enemy has snipers or wall pockets
objective_contracts.false_positive: Poison tags and reveal can farm low-risk stars, but Crow's 5600 HP and low burst make him a poor star holder when enemies outrange him on open maps like Dry Season.

needs_teammate_support: teammate burst or control to bring targets into Crow's cleanup window
anti-aggro peel if enemy divers can bypass poison range
objective_contracts.false_positive: Crow can punish slowed or chipped targets, but Knockout deaths are permanent and his low health means a blind dive or open-lane trade against Belle's Rock snipers is a trap.

low_health_pressure.active_when: enemy can force close-range contact before Crow has Super, Gadget, or teammate peel
low_health_pressure.mitigation: play at max tag range, pair with anti-aggro teammate, or choose Slowing Toxin/Extra Toxic

outranged_open_map.active_when: enemy snipers or high-damage long-range picks hold open lanes and Crow cannot safely apply poison
outranged_open_map.mitigation: draft Crow on bush/route maps or after bans remove long-lane punishers

chip_without_objective_conversion.active_when: Crow repeatedly poisons targets but team lacks a scorer, safe DPS, zone body, or finisher
chip_without_objective_conversion.mitigation: pair with burst, carrier, frontliner, or safe DPS depending on mode

spawnable_or_wall_pocket_tax.active_when: enemy spawnables, porters, turrets, or thrower pockets absorb Crow's low damage and block priority tags
spawnable_or_wall_pocket_tax.mitigation: add wallbreak, splash, or a teammate that clears bodies before relying on poison pressure

slot_notes.slot_1: acceptable only when map rewards poison vision/anti-heal and bans protect him from long-range or hard dive punishment.

Super 抢宝是应急工具，不应当作默认 carrier 计划

can_fulfill: 对高血量后排稳定削血
Push It 把目标推到队友射线
Na-ah! 拉近创造收割窗口
objective_contracts.false_positive: Colette 的百分比伤害对低血 Bounty 目标接近最低伤害地板，无法稳定收尾；Dry Season 等极开阔图还会被更长狙击 outrange

can_fulfill: 对高血量前排稳定削血制造首杀窗口
Push It 推开/打断敌方开团
Super 往返收低血目标压缩缩圈空间
needs_teammate_support: 长线 anchor、收割手、反 burst/CC
objective_contracts.false_positive: Knockout 死亡不可恢复，Colette 的 Super 路径会被 Bull/Edgar/Shelly/Buzz 等 burst 守住；在没有确认敌方 burst/CC 已交时冲入会直接送点

super_cycle_is_not_a_fixed_four_hits.active_when: 阵容把 Colette 的下一次 Super 当成四次命中后的固定资源，包括误以为 Gotcha! 三发加一发普通攻击即可充满
super_cycle_is_not_a_fixed_four_hits.mitigation: 无既有充能时按 5 次有效命中预算 Super；Gotcha! 只用于续航和缩小充能缺口，不用它承诺四发循环

low_health_target_damage_floor.active_when: 敌人已低血，Colette 普攻只打最低伤害而无法立刻收割
low_health_target_damage_floor.mitigation: 用 Damage gear、Na-ah!、队友收割或保留 Super 完成最后一段

super_path_burst_or_cc.active_when: Colette Super 路径经过 Bull、Edgar、Shelly、Buzz、Nani、Emz 等 burst/CC 位置
super_path_burst_or_cc.mitigation: 先耗 ammo/控制，使用 Mass Tax，或只用 Push It 打断安全目标

push_it_displaces_out_of_followup.active_when: Push It 把远程目标推离 Colette 和队友可追击范围
push_it_displaces_out_of_followup.mitigation: 只在目标收益是清门/推出圈/保证两段命中时用

summon_or_wall_control_target_dilution.active_when: 敌方用 Mr. P、Larry & Lawrie、Eve、Tara 等召唤/墙控稀释 Colette 的单目标节奏
summon_or_wall_control_target_dilution.mitigation: 补清召唤物、开墙或改用更稳定 area damage

slot_notes.slot_1: Heist 或高前排模式可早手，但要准备回答召唤物和墙后控制
slot_notes.slot_2_3: 适合在敌方先出 tank/body 后补，直接定义反前排职责
slot_notes.slot_4_5: 看到球门/热区/safe 有明确位移收益时，Colette 的 Push It 价值上升
slot_notes.slot_6: 可惩罚高血量目标和无 body-block 的后排；不能修补队伍缺 area clear

poison_vision_and_carrier_retreat_tax.objective_conversion: protect gem carrier retreat, reveal flank pressure, and stop hidden enemies from healing before a countdown or zone fight
poison_vision_and_carrier_retreat_tax.active_when: map rewards bush scouting and Crow can tag enemies without overcommitting into thrower or sniper range
poison_vision_and_carrier_retreat_tax.fails_if: grass is burned, walls block repeated tags, or enemy outranges Crow on the route

anti_heal_slow_zone_entry.objective_conversion: delay zone re-entry, reduce tank damage during a push, or create a teammate finish window on slowed targets
anti_heal_slow_zone_entry.active_when: enemy plan needs healing, grouped entry, or close-range bodies to walk through a predictable lane, and allies can convert within the 3-tick poison / 4-second anti-heal window
anti_heal_slow_zone_entry.fails_if: enemy controls from behind a wall, spreads across lanes, or Crow is forced to stand on zone as the main body

jump_score_or_cleanup_window.objective_conversion: turn chip damage into a kill, retrieve a self-pass, or bypass a short defender for a score attempt
jump_score_or_cleanup_window.active_when: target is below half, slowed, or isolated and Crow still has enough health or shield to survive landing
jump_score_or_cleanup_window.fails_if: enemy holds knockback/burst, target is behind multiple teammates, or goal geometry remains closed

heist_lane_attrition_not_primary_dps.objective_conversion: convert lane chip into safe access for a DPS teammate or deny enemy short-range safe entry
heist_lane_attrition_not_primary_dps.active_when: team already has safe DPS and Crow's job is lane control, anti-heal, and anti-aggro defense
heist_lane_attrition_not_primary_dps.fails_if: draft expects Crow to be the main safe damage source or enemy wins with longer range/cross-lane DPS

needs_teammate_support: durable carrier or mid control teammate
wallbreak/thrower answer if enemies hide behind pockets
objective_contracts.false_positive: Poison can reveal and delay, but Crow's low health makes him a poor solo carrier when the enemy has long-range focus.

needs_teammate_support: peel after Crow spends Super aggressively
objective_contracts.false_positive: Crow can create or finish a score window; he does not solve closed goals or front-line holding by himself.

needs_teammate_support: lane winner that converts poisoned defenders into safe hits
objective_contracts.false_positive: Heist Crow is a control/defense layer; drafting him as the sole race tool is a trap.

needs_teammate_support: area clear or wallbreak against pocket control
objective_contracts.false_positive: Crow helps win the edge of the zone; he still needs teammates to occupy and clear the circle.

needs_teammate_support: teammate to hold star lead and convert poisoned targets
long-range or wallbreak answer if enemy has snipers or wall pockets
objective_contracts.false_positive: Poison tags and reveal can farm low-risk stars, but Crow's 5600 HP and low burst make him a poor star holder when enemies outrange him on open maps like Dry Season.

needs_teammate_support: teammate burst or control to bring targets into Crow's cleanup window
anti-aggro peel if enemy divers can bypass poison range
objective_contracts.false_positive: Crow can punish slowed or chipped targets, but Knockout deaths are permanent and his low health means a blind dive or open-lane trade against Belle's Rock snipers is a trap.

low_health_pressure.active_when: enemy can force close-range contact before Crow has Super, Gadget, or teammate peel
low_health_pressure.mitigation: play at max tag range, pair with anti-aggro teammate, or choose Slowing Toxin/Extra Toxic

outranged_open_map.active_when: enemy snipers or high-damage long-range picks hold open lanes and Crow cannot safely apply poison
outranged_open_map.mitigation: draft Crow on bush/route maps or after bans remove long-lane punishers

chip_without_objective_conversion.active_when: Crow repeatedly poisons targets but team lacks a scorer, safe DPS, zone body, or finisher
chip_without_objective_conversion.mitigation: pair with burst, carrier, frontliner, or safe DPS depending on mode

spawnable_or_wall_pocket_tax.active_when: enemy spawnables, porters, turrets, or thrower pockets absorb Crow's low damage and block priority tags
spawnable_or_wall_pocket_tax.mitigation: add wallbreak, splash, or a teammate that clears bodies before relying on poison pressure

slot_notes.slot_1: acceptable only when map rewards poison vision/anti-heal and bans protect him from long-range or hard dive punishment.
slot_notes.slot_2_3: good into early sustain, tank, or bush-control plans if the team already has objective conversion.
slot_notes.slot_4_5: use to add anti-heal, reveal, and slow after seeing enemy front line, while keeping a final slot for body or damage.
slot_notes.slot_6: punishes drafts that lack long-range answer, cleanse, spawnable tax, or a way to stop a slowed low-health cleanup jump.

objective_contracts: Heist 目标访问有两条主线：可过水/越墙进入敌方半场，或远程/抛物线不进半场也能打库。

route_gates.condition: 河道阻断普通步行进库路线
route_gates.payoff: 能过河且能打库/站住才有价值
route_gates.bp_use: 不要把“会过水”单独当加分项

route_gates.condition: 部分远程或特殊弹道不用过河也能打到金库
route_gates.payoff: 绕过河道问题制造稳定 DPS
route_gates.bp_use: 可作为先手基本面或回答敌方进库路线

route_gates.condition: 敌方不分路会让中路人数密度升高
route_gates.payoff: 放大连锁/穿透/召唤物收益
route_gates.bp_use: 评估前序 pick 是否会导致敌方聚中

route_gates.condition: 金库附近角落能让部分英雄反复存活
route_gates.payoff: 把一次入侵变成持续牵制或输出
route_gates.bp_use: 适合最后手惩罚缺少基地清理的阵容

hard_gates.requirement: provide safe pressure, safe defense, counter-race value, or a named way to enable those jobs

false_positive_filters.reason: 不要把“会过水”单独当加分项
可作为先手基本面或回答敌方进库路线
评估前序 pick 是否会导致敌方聚中
适合最后手惩罚缺少基地清理的阵容

false_positive_filters.if: 候选只有 water_crossing 但手短
false_positive_filters.then: 标记为 false_positive
false_positive_filters.because: 路线打开不等于目标访问成立
false_positive_filters.bp_use: 要求额外战术价值或队友压制

false_positive_filters.if: 敌方无基地清理/反入侵
false_positive_filters.then: 金库角落锚点升值
false_positive_filters.because: 入侵英雄能反复牵制和打库
false_positive_filters.bp_use: 后手可选持续入侵型英雄

false_positive_filters.then: 连锁、穿透、炮台和长线控制升值
false_positive_filters.because: 中路拥挤放大多目标收益

false_positive_filters.note: 能过水但打不到金库、站不住或无法迫使回防的英雄是典型假阳性。
远程角度必须看弹道可靠性和敌方 dive 威胁，不是所有长手都稳定。

stinging_flight_empower_damage_shield_ga.build: Stinging Flight / Empower / Damage, Shield, Gadget Cooldown

long_sightline.objective_conversion: early pick pressure, zone denial by threat, and safe poke
long_sightline.active_when: Angelo can charge safely and enemy cannot hide after each shot
long_sightline.fails_if: walls or summons absorb arrows, or pressure interrupts charge

water_crossing_or_obstacle_bypass.objective_conversion: Heist safe access, Knockout retreat angle, Hot Zone safe poke
water_crossing_or_obstacle_bypass.active_when: water route gives range or objective pressure rather than only movement
water_crossing_or_obstacle_bypass.fails_if: crossing water puts Angelo in short-range trap or away from objective damage

heist_safe_entry_window.objective_conversion: burst safe damage or force defenders to turn back
heist_safe_entry_window.active_when: entry is protected by teammate pressure and Angelo can leave or survive after Super
heist_safe_entry_window.fails_if: enemy has immediate anti-dive, safe route is watched, or Angelo dies before damage converts

objective_contracts.false_positive: Water access is a trap if it does not create a safe damage window
One-shot pressure can disappear if enemies use summons or force Angelo to stop charging
If gas or walls remove retreat space, Angelo's charge cycle becomes fragile
Long arrow can hold mine approaches, but charge cycle and lack of reveal make Angelo a poor solo carrier.
Water access does not create a goal route unless a scorer and wallbreak are already drafted.
Poison cloud adds pressure but cannot convert to zone time without a body brawler standing in.

charge_cycle_interrupted.active_when: Angelo is knocked back, pulled, stunned, or forced to cancel charged aim
charge_cycle_interrupted.mitigation: charge from protected angle, use water route, or keep Stinging Flight for reset

no_auto_regen_while_charging.active_when: poke damage accumulates while Angelo holds charge and cannot auto-heal
no_auto_regen_while_charging.mitigation: Empower, Shield gear, shorter charge cycles, or healer support

water_route_without_pressure.active_when: water movement exists but does not create range, safe damage, or retreat value
water_route_without_pressure.mitigation: only count water if it opens a real objective route or safe off-angle

wall_or_summon_absorbs_single_arrow.active_when: enemy plays behind wall, deploys bodies, or rotates during Angelo charge
wall_or_summon_absorbs_single_arrow.mitigation: Master Fletcher, wallbreak teammate, or choose open lane

slot_notes.slot_1: 适合在水图或极开阔长线图先手；需要避开敌方低成本召唤物/投掷 2-3 回答。
slot_notes.slot_2_3: 可回答敌方普通射手或建立 Heist 进库路线，但要配一手处理投掷/召唤物。
slot_notes.slot_4_5: 用于补远程爆发、水路访问或 safe burst；必须检查敌方 6 位是否能补硬突进。
slot_notes.slot_6: 当敌方缺召唤物、投掷和连段突脸时，Angelo 可作为高收益长线惩罚位。

ghost_train_tickets_please_variants_with.build: Ghost Train / Tickets Please variants (with Buffies)

heist_post_safe_route_loop.objective_conversion: convert the opening charge pool into a bounded safe-damage burst and forced defensive attention
heist_post_safe_route_loop.active_when: Chuck can place route Posts before the race is lost and the charge budget covers the dashes the plan needs
heist_post_safe_route_loop.fails_if: the pool is spent on setup and lane trades before safe contact, the enemy wins faster safe DPS, camps the last Post, or silence/cocoon/CC stops the dash cycle

safe_barrier_wall_bypass_and_route_retar.objective_conversion: bypass protected Heist walls, punish a thrower pocket, or alter endpoint timing after defenders start camping
safe_barrier_wall_bypass_and_route_retar.active_when: walls are the main cost to target access and Chuck still holds a charge plus Ghost Train timing to change the route
safe_barrier_wall_bypass_and_route_retar.fails_if: the map opens into long-range DPS after wallbreak, Ghost Train is spent without objective contact, or the endpoint is guarded by anti-aggro

post_rotation_carrier_or_zone_chase.objective_conversion: catch a carrier, retreat with gems, or re-enter zone faster than normal rotation
post_rotation_carrier_or_zone_chase.active_when: Chuck holds enough charges to place route anchors and still dash, and the objective path remains predictable
post_rotation_carrier_or_zone_chase.fails_if: charges run out mid-rotation, a goal or round reset removes Posts, the enemy camps the endpoint, or route pressure does not convert into gems or zone time

needs_teammate_support: early lane pressure while Chuck spends charges on Posts
answers to silence, cocoon, knockback, or endpoint campers
objective_contracts.false_positive: Chuck is a Heist burst-route pick: the opening pool buys one bounded safe window, and once charges are gone he has neither the cycle nor the raw DPS to keep racing.

needs_teammate_support: mid control that buys time to place route Posts
objective_contracts.false_positive: Fandom notes Gem Grab utility, but every rotation burns a finite charge; treat Gem Grab as conditional route tech, not a repeating chase engine.
Chuck arrives quickly on the opening pool, but arrival is not zone control if enemies wait on the endpoint or the pool is spent on rotations.

needs_teammate_support: scorer and wallbreak/control if goal geometry is closed
early lane pressure while Chuck places Posts
objective_contracts.false_positive: Chuck's route dash can disrupt a ball lane, but PLP recommends only Heist; he does not solve scoring or carrying, and Posts reset on every goal so each possession costs fresh charges.

needs_teammate_support: marksman or long-range teammate to control open sightlines
lane protection during the setup window
objective_contracts.false_positive: Bounty maps reward low-commitment star pressure; Chuck's value is one bounded route window, so he is a weak Bounty fit that should not be drafted as a star source.

needs_teammate_support: ranged lane teammate to hold space and force predictable routes
bait or ban for Charlie, Otis, Cordelius-style denial before Chuck commits
objective_contracts.false_positive: Every round starts with a full pool, but Knockout deaths are unrecoverable and spent charges are lost with them; the route dash is a round-one punish tool, not a stable lane pick, and first-picking him invites denial answers.

charge_budget_exhaustion.active_when: the opening 4-charge pool is spent on Posts, lane trades, or early dashes before objective value converts, with refill limited to hit-based Super charge
charge_budget_exhaustion.mitigation: sequence Posts and dashes so the decisive objective dash still has a charge, and use Rerouting's 50% refund to stretch the pool

post_route_predictability.active_when: Chuck repeats the same route and enemies camp the final Post
post_route_predictability.mitigation: use Rerouting to move a Post while refunding 50% of a charge, alternate endpoints, or draft pressure that punishes endpoint campers

super_denial_or_control_interrupt.active_when: enemy can mute, cocoon, knock back, slow, stun, or send Chuck away before dash value converts, wasting charges from a non-refillable pool
super_denial_or_control_interrupt.mitigation: avoid into cheap Super denial or force those tools on a different lane before committing the charge pool

raw_laning_without_posts.active_when: Chuck is forced into standard lane fighting after his charges are spent and no useful post graph remains
raw_laning_without_posts.mitigation: evaluate him by route-to-objective, not by generic lane DPS, and time the charge pool around objective spawns

slot_notes.slot_1: only on Heist maps where the post-safe route is a core plan and the opening charge window can be spent on the safe before denial answers arrive.
slot_notes.slot_2_3: usable early because the Super starts full, but pair with immediate lane/safe pressure so the finite pool is not traded away before the route exists.
slot_notes.slot_4_5: best when enemy 2-3 lack Super denial or endpoint camping and the team still needs a bounded objective-access window.
slot_notes.slot_6: punishes drafts that cannot stop a fixed safe route after bans/picks have removed Charlie, Otis, Cordelius, or endpoint tanks; the opening full pool makes late picks immediately live.

objective_contracts: Heist race 不只看 DPS，还看谁能从草丛或侧路安全转入金库输出。

route_gates.condition: 斜草带允许伏击、换线和中路穿插
route_gates.payoff: 可把中路控制转化为金库入口
route_gates.bp_use: BP 需要探草/扫草与反伏击资源

route_gates.condition: 侧路分割让边路远程和单路压制有独立价值
route_gates.payoff: 赢边路后能进入金库输出窗口
route_gates.bp_use: 阵容不能三人只打中路

route_gates.condition: 墙体角度允许投掷或绕射低风险施压
route_gates.payoff: 给金库或防守位持续压力
route_gates.bp_use: 后手需要 anti_thrower dive 或 wall break

hard_gates.requirement: provide safe pressure, safe defense, counter-race value, or a named way to enable those jobs

false_positive_filters.reason: BP 需要探草/扫草与反伏击资源
阵容不能三人只打中路
后手需要 anti_thrower dive 或 wall break

false_positive_filters.then: 斜草伏击和 speed 侧压升值
false_positive_filters.because: 草带贯穿中部，能打乱 Heist race 节奏
false_positive_filters.bp_use: 可用草丛侧压作为后手

false_positive_filters.if: 敌方投掷占到右侧角度
false_positive_filters.then: 需要开墙、突进或远程压制
false_positive_filters.because: 否则会低风险拖防守并磨金库

false_positive_filters.if: 我方只有中路火力没有边路
false_positive_filters.then: 金库触达会不稳定
false_positive_filters.because: Heist 胜负取决于持续打库窗口
false_positive_filters.bp_use: 补可赢边路的 safe DPS

false_positive_filters.note: 草丛伏击在被烧草/探草后急剧贬值。
投掷没有队友压线时容易被侧路突进处理。

mitigates_failure_modes: 纯普攻难以瞬间清前排
popping_pincushion_curveball_shield_dama.bp_use: 默认竞技 build；地图/模式要求 close burst 或目标区控制时价值最高

mitigates_failure_modes: 被远程单发或投掷 chip 压出位置
life_plant_fertilize_sustain_variant.bp_use: Hot Zone/Gem Grab 需要活在目标边缘时的 build requirement

zone_choke_slow_and_area.objective_conversion: Hot Zone 站圈时间、重进场税和防守反打
zone_choke_slow_and_area.active_when: Spike 已通过约 4 发普通直接命中或多段尖刺命中取得 Super，且热区入口/L 墙附近形成敌方必须经过的重复路线
zone_choke_slow_and_area.fails_if: 敌方投掷/长手从圈外清 Spike，或目标有跳跃/无敌/强位移绕开区域

gem_mine_curveball_control.objective_conversion: 控矿、保护 carrier、惩罚敌方倒计时撤退
gem_mine_curveball_control.active_when: 宝石矿附近有入口/草边/墙角让敌人反复经过
gem_mine_curveball_control.fails_if: 敌方投掷占深口袋，或 Spike 被长手从安全距离压退

brawl_ball_goal_choke_and_anti_tank.objective_conversion: 防守进球、创造射门窗口、惩罚坦克推进
brawl_ball_goal_choke_and_anti_tank.active_when: 球路经过草口、窄口或门前防守区，队友能接 slow 后的击杀
brawl_ball_goal_choke_and_anti_tank.fails_if: 敌方投掷/位移 scorer 从侧路绕开，或我方没有破门/得分手

heist_popping_pincushion_safe_or_defense.objective_conversion: 短窗口 safe burst、反入库坦克、迫使防守资源
heist_popping_pincushion_safe_or_defense.active_when: Spike 能通过线权/草墙接近 safe，或敌方前排必须进入他的爆发区
heist_popping_pincushion_safe_or_defense.fails_if: 开阔长线让 Spike 永远摸不到 safe，或敌方远程 race 更快

can_fulfill: Curveball 控矿和 carrier 退线 slow
Super 切 carrier 撤退路线并保护倒计时拾宝

can_fulfill: Super 区口 slow 和路线封锁
needs_teammate_support: 实际站区 body、投掷/长线答案
objective_contracts.false_positive: Super 控区强，但需要约 4 发直接命中充能；区被清/未充好时不构成基础控制

can_fulfill: 中距离多段尖刺压制固定射线后排
Super slow 惩罚前排 peek 制造星差窗口

can_fulfill: choke/草口 Super slow 创造第一减员窗口
贴近多段爆发收割被 slow 的目标
needs_teammate_support: 先手 chip、硬控/视野、反机动 peel
objective_contracts.false_positive: Super slow 区会被跳跃/dash 绕过；多路线开阔 KO 图上 Spike 不是稳定 first pick

只有能摸到 safe 或能反入库时才是 Heist 候选

super_control_requires_charge_setup.active_when: 阵容把 Spike 的 slow zone 当作开局或每波必有的基础控制，但他尚未完成普通约 4 发直接命中的充能循环

Nita's attack range is only 6 tiles and her mobility is low; on pure open Bounty maps she gets outranged before charging Super, so Bruce pressure only matters when walls, chokepoints, or bushes let her actually reach a grouped lane.

Knockout deaths are permanent and Bruce can be burst down before value; if the enemy has splash/thrower/chain clear, Nita's Super feeds a pick instead of creating a catch window, so she is a late situational pick, not an open-map staple.

hard_gates.requirement: provide mine control, carrier safety, carrier punish, or a named support plan for those jobs

BP 中必须配探草或可靠边路
落后方可用探草、跳入或拉人制造翻盘

poison_vision_and_carrier_retreat_tax.objective_conversion: protect gem carrier retreat, reveal flank pressure, and stop hidden enemies from healing before a countdown or zone fight
poison_vision_and_carrier_retreat_tax.active_when: map rewards bush scouting and Crow can tag enemies without overcommitting into thrower or sniper range
poison_vision_and_carrier_retreat_tax.fails_if: grass is burned, walls block repeated tags, or enemy outranges Crow on the route

anti_heal_slow_zone_entry.objective_conversion: delay zone re-entry, reduce tank damage during a push, or create a teammate finish window on slowed targets
anti_heal_slow_zone_entry.active_when: enemy plan needs healing, grouped entry, or close-range bodies to walk through a predictable lane, and allies can convert within the 3-tick poison / 4-second anti-heal window
anti_heal_slow_zone_entry.fails_if: enemy controls from behind a wall, spreads across lanes, or Crow is forced to stand on zone as the main body

jump_score_or_cleanup_window.objective_conversion: turn chip damage into a kill, retrieve a self-pass, or bypass a short defender for a score attempt
jump_score_or_cleanup_window.active_when: target is below half, slowed, or isolated and Crow still has enough health or shield to survive landing
jump_score_or_cleanup_window.fails_if: enemy holds knockback/burst, target is behind multiple teammates, or goal geometry remains closed

heist_lane_attrition_not_primary_dps.objective_conversion: convert lane chip into safe access for a DPS teammate or deny enemy short-range safe entry
heist_lane_attrition_not_primary_dps.active_when: team already has safe DPS and Crow's job is lane control, anti-heal, and anti-aggro defense
heist_lane_attrition_not_primary_dps.fails_if: draft expects Crow to be the main safe damage source or enemy wins with longer range/cross-lane DPS

needs_teammate_support: durable carrier or mid control teammate
wallbreak/thrower answer if enemies hide behind pockets
objective_contracts.false_positive: Poison can reveal and delay, but Crow's low health makes him a poor solo carrier when the enemy has long-range focus.

needs_teammate_support: peel after Crow spends Super aggressively
objective_contracts.false_positive: Crow can create or finish a score window; he does not solve closed goals or front-line holding by himself.

needs_teammate_support: lane winner that converts poisoned defenders into safe hits
objective_contracts.false_positive: Heist Crow is a control/defense layer; drafting him as the sole race tool is a trap.

needs_teammate_support: area clear or wallbreak against pocket control
objective_contracts.false_positive: Crow helps win the edge of the zone; he still needs teammates to occupy and clear the circle.

needs_teammate_support: teammate to hold star lead and convert poisoned targets
long-range or wallbreak answer if enemy has snipers or wall pockets
objective_contracts.false_positive: Poison tags and reveal can farm low-risk stars, but Crow's 5600 HP and low burst make him a poor star holder when enemies outrange him on open maps like Dry Season.

needs_teammate_support: teammate burst or control to bring targets into Crow's cleanup window
anti-aggro peel if enemy divers can bypass poison range
objective_contracts.false_positive: Crow can punish slowed or chipped targets, but Knockout deaths are permanent and his low health means a blind dive or open-lane trade against Belle's Rock snipers is a trap.

low_health_pressure.active_when: enemy can force close-range contact before Crow has Super, Gadget, or teammate peel
low_health_pressure.mitigation: play at max tag range, pair with anti-aggro teammate, or choose Slowing Toxin/Extra Toxic

outranged_open_map.active_when: enemy snipers or high-damage long-range picks hold open lanes and Crow cannot safely apply poison
outranged_open_map.mitigation: draft Crow on bush/route maps or after bans remove long-lane punishers

chip_without_objective_conversion.active_when: Crow repeatedly poisons targets but team lacks a scorer, safe DPS, zone body, or finisher
chip_without_objective_conversion.mitigation: pair with burst, carrier, frontliner, or safe DPS depending on mode

spawnable_or_wall_pocket_tax.active_when: enemy spawnables, porters, turrets, or thrower pockets absorb Crow's low damage and block priority tags
spawnable_or_wall_pocket_tax.mitigation: add wallbreak, splash, or a teammate that clears bodies before relying on poison pressure

slot_notes.slot_1: acceptable only when map rewards poison vision/anti-heal and bans protect him from long-range or hard dive punishment.
slot_notes.slot_2_3: good into early sustain, tank, or bush-control plans if the team already has objective conversion.
slot_notes.slot_4_5: use to add anti-heal, reveal, and slow after seeing enemy front line, while keeping a final slot for body or damage.
slot_notes.slot_6: punishes drafts that lack long-range answer, cleanse, spawnable tax, or a way to stop a slowed low-health cleanup jump.

Nita's attack range is only 6 tiles and her mobility is low; on pure open Bounty maps she gets outranged before charging Super, so Bruce pressure only matters when walls, chokepoints, or bushes let her actually reach a grouped lane.

Knockout deaths are permanent and Bruce can be burst down before value; if the enemy has splash/thrower/chain clear, Nita's Super feeds a pick instead of creating a catch window, so she is a late situational pick, not an open-map staple.

cannon_shots_are_dodgeable.active_when: BP 只依赖炮台命中开阔地移动目标
cannon_shots_are_dodgeable.mitigation: 把炮台用于逼走位/封路，配队友射线惩罚移动，而不是单独指望命中

barrel_and_cannon_liability.active_when: 敌方有穿透、弹射、thrower、splash 或 Penny mirror
barrel_and_cannon_liability.mitigation: 避免资源与 Penny 重叠，换炮台位，或先 ban/处理低成本清除者

master_blaster_timing_window.active_when: Penny 无 Super 或炮台落点离突进者太远
master_blaster_timing_window.mitigation: 保留 Super 给真实突进终点，或用 barrel 先挡第一轮

slot_notes.slot_1: 有明确炮台藏位、敌方缺资源清除时可早手；否则会被后手投掷/弹射克制
slot_notes.slot_2_3: 适合作为 Gem/Hot Zone 控图区核心，后续补站区 body 和长线收割
slot_notes.slot_4_5: 看到敌方召唤物/body block/聚堆站点时可响应，但要检查反炮台工具
slot_notes.slot_6: 最后手可惩罚无穿透/投掷的阵容，或用桶安全打 Heist 角度

candy_beans_single_bellomania_speed_dama.build: Candy Beans / Single Bellomania / Speed, Damage
enables: Brawl Ball 中场/门前反突进
Hot Zone 入口爆发清人
Gem Grab 矿区 bodyguard 或反切

brawl_ball_close_bell_burst_and_super_ut.objective_conversion: 击杀/眩晕持球者，逼退门前防守，或用随机 Super 创造一次射门窗口
brawl_ball_close_bell_burst_and_super_ut.active_when: Chester 已预热到多铃，球路会经过中近距离，队友能接球或补伤害
brawl_ball_close_bell_burst_and_super_ut.fails_if: Chester 只有低铃序列、Super 不匹配，或敌方在开阔长线先把他压低

hot_zone_pop_rocks_or_jawbreaker_entry_p.objective_conversion: 清掉进圈目标、打断回区、给己方 body 站区时间
hot_zone_pop_rocks_or_jawbreaker_entry_p.active_when: 目标必须反复进入同一入口，Chester 有合适 Super 或多铃爆发
hot_zone_pop_rocks_or_jawbreaker_entry_p.fails_if: 随机 Super 不适配当前 zone fight，或敌方用长手/投掷从圈外清 Chester

gem_mid_sequence_burst_bodyguard.objective_conversion: 保护 carrier、清敌方进矿 body，或在倒计时阶段反打追击者
gem_mid_sequence_burst_bodyguard.active_when: 己方已有 carrier，Chester 站在中近距离保护位而不是裸站开阔中路
gem_mid_sequence_burst_bodyguard.fails_if: 敌方长手站远端消耗，或 Chester 被迫自己拿宝石承受多角度压力

knockout_random_super_last_pick_swing.objective_conversion: 用 stun、knockback、毒伤或区域 slow 拿第一杀或保护血量领先
knockout_random_super_last_pick_swing.active_when: 敌方缺多长手压制，回合会进入中距离或墙边接触
knockout_random_super_last_pick_swing.fails_if: 地图是纯开放狙击镜像，Chester 在进入铃铛爆发距离前被打残

objective_contracts.false_positive: PLP Gem Grab 信号不能直接推出 Chester 能打所有矿图；他需要中近距离接触点
Chester 能制造门前爆发窗口，但随机 Super 不保证每次都有进球工具
Chester 清人强于长期站区；无队友站圈时价值会断
Fandom 说 Knockout 可行，条件是能接触到中距离，而非开阔图硬对狙

can_fulfill: Candy Popper 偶发破墙打库窗口
多铃近身爆发清守库者
随机 Super 短窗辅助 safe 接触
needs_teammate_support: 真正 safe DPS、开路、反控制
objective_contracts.false_positive: Chester 的 Heist 价值依赖随机抽到 Candy Popper 或合适 Super，不是稳定 race 核心；把他当主打库手会因 RNG 失败

can_fulfill: 多铃近身爆发惩罚无 peel 后排
随机 Super (stun/knockback) 创造拿星窗口
needs_teammate_support: 长线 anchor、压血、反 body peel
objective_contracts.false_positive: Dry Season、Shooting Star 等极开阔 Bounty 图惩罚中近距离爆发英雄；Chester 只在敌方后排脆且缺 peel 时作最后手惩罚，随机 Super 也无法保证对狙价值

random_super_variance.active_when: 当前 Super 与目标任务不匹配，例如需要 stun 但只有 heal/poison，或需要 wallbreak 但没有 Candy Popper
random_super_variance.mitigation: 进入关键团前记录 Super 类型，必要时使用 Spicy Dice 变体

sequence_misalignment.active_when: Chester 以 1 铃或 2 铃进入必须爆发的近身对抗
sequence_misalignment.mitigation: 开局/团前预热铃铛，保留 3/4 铃给刺客、持球者或坦克

open_sniper_range_tax.active_when: Piper、Belle、Angelo、Byron 等在开阔长线持续输出，Chester 不能进入多铃有效距离
open_sniper_range_tax.mitigation: 只在有墙、草、队友压线或中距离目标点时选

candy_beans_rng_window.active_when: Candy Beans roll 出的 buff 不是当前需要的 damage/reload/speed/heal
candy_beans_rng_window.mitigation: 按当前 20% damage / 2.5x reload / 150 speed / 420 HPS 的 5 秒随机结果估算，并把 15 秒冷却后的下一次使用当独立资源；不写成确定开团能力

slot_notes.slot_1: 不宜盲先手，除非地图天然进入中近距离且敌方难以用长手压制；随机资源会给后续阵容留下反制口。
slot_notes.slot_2_3: 可作为反突进/中距离爆发计划手，但需要队友补稳定长线或站点职责。
slot_notes.slot_4_5: 适合回答已暴露的刺客、坦克或固定 objective body，同时避免把纯开阔长手留给敌方 slot_6。
slot_notes.slot_6: 最适合作为高上限后手，在确认敌方缺多长手和硬资源层后用随机 Super 工具箱压制局部。

relations_with_allies_not_synergy_eviden.mechanism: 极长线或稳定长手在 Chester 进入多铃爆发距离前压低血量，并让随机 Super 工具难以触发
relations_with_allies_not_synergy_eviden.active_when: 地图开放、缺墙草接近路线，Chester 队伍不能压缩距离
relations_with_allies_not_synergy_eviden.fails_when: 墙体/草线让 Chester 能预热后进入中近距离，或长手被队友先压退

phat_splatter_ink_refills_shield_speed_d.build: Phat Splatter / Ink Refills / Shield + Speed + Damage + Vision + Super Charge
mitigates_failure_modes: 纯靠 Super 命中导致输出不足
phat_splatter_ink_refills_shield_speed_d.bp_use: 默认竞技 build 候选；Gear 根据地图草丛/站圈/伤害需求切换

mitigates_failure_modes: 需要提前封路线但 Otis 不能直接命中进场者
dormant_star_chokepoint_variant.bp_use: 地图有明确 choke/入口时的条件 build

lane_funnel_or_choke.objective_conversion: 阻断 Brawl Ball 进球窗口、Hot Zone 进圈、Heist 入库
lane_funnel_or_choke.active_when: 地图目标通路窄，敌方依赖突进或 Super 进场
lane_funnel_or_choke.fails_if: 敌方能远程绕墙消耗，或触发后我方无法跟进击杀

base_entry_route.objective_conversion: Heist 防入库，同时可转安全输出
base_entry_route.active_when: 敌方依赖 Bull/Edgar/Buzz/Darryl/Fang 等进场打库
base_entry_route.fails_if: 敌方 safe damage 来自长线/投掷而非近身入库

grass_anchor.objective_conversion: 降低伏击/Speed Gear 进场收益
grass_anchor.fails_if: 敌方能烧草、投掷或远程无视草丛对线

objective_contracts.false_positive: 如果敌方主要是远程打库，Otis 的 anti-aggro 价值会下降
防守强不等于阵容有进球窗口
被投掷隔墙清圈时，Otis 可能站不住圈

can_fulfill: Super mute 封锁 carrier 或守宝者操作
Ink Refills 持续压矿区撤退线
Phat Splatter 覆盖矿区草丛暴露 carrier
needs_teammate_support: 主 carrier、收割被 mute 目标、反投掷
objective_contracts.false_positive: mute 命中后若队友无法补伤害/控 carrier，Otis 的封锁无法转成掉宝

can_fulfill: Super mute 封锁保星后排或长手操作
Ink Refills 在长线持续压低血目标
Phat Splatter 暴露墙后保星位
needs_teammate_support: 长手保星、收割 mute 目标、反刺客 peel
objective_contracts.false_positive: Otis 的 mute 是单点封锁；Bounty 开阔图 mute 错目标或无 followup 等于浪费 Super

can_fulfill: Super mute 封锁首杀候选或回末站桩者
Dormant Star choke blocker 封缩圈路线
Ink Refills 持续压回末低血
needs_teammate_support: 视野、补伤、逼敌方经过 choke 或暴露核心目标
objective_contracts.false_positive: mute 在单命模式是高收益高风险；miss 或 mute 非核心目标会让回合陷入被动

mute_misses_or_no_followup.active_when: Super 未命中，或命中后队友无法补伤害/控目标
mute_misses_or_no_followup.mitigation: Super Charge Gear、先用控线逼位、搭配爆发队友

outranged_by_throwers_or_wall_control.active_when: 敌方 Barley/Larry_and_Lawrie/Willow 等能隔墙压制，Otis 无法直接命中
outranged_by_throwers_or_wall_control.mitigation: 开墙、绕侧路、或让队友回答投掷

defensive_value_without_win_condition.active_when: Otis 只负责防突进，但我方缺 safe DPS/进球/站圈转换
defensive_value_without_win_condition.mitigation: 与 scorer、safe DPS 或 zone body 搭配

slot_notes.slot_1: 在 Heist/Brawl Ball/Hot Zone 若地图进场路线明确，可以作为稳定 anti-aggro 控制先手；纯长线图不宜裸先。
slot_notes.slot_2_3: 很适合回答敌方坦克、刺客、Chuck/Sam 类进场计划，同时建立防守基本面。
slot_notes.slot_4_5: 用于修补己方缺 anti-aggro 或站圈清圈的问题，但要补投掷答案。
slot_notes.slot_6: 如果敌方三人已暴露近身进场且缺投掷/长线保护，Otis 可作为高收益惩罚位。

objective_contracts: Gem Grab 的目标访问依赖中路站位与倒计时撤退；侧路击杀和探草能改变宝石持有者的退路。

route_gates.condition: 中心双螺旋草丛提供连续接近和伏击路线
route_gates.payoff: 允许侧路或中路英雄逼退宝石矿附近站位
route_gates.bp_use: 必须优先确认队伍是否有探草/扫草；没有视野时长手价值降级

route_gates.condition: 侧路草带连接敌我半场，允许多角度绕后
route_gates.payoff: 通过侧压迫使敌方 gem carrier 后撤或交资源
route_gates.bp_use: 适合中后手补侧路压力，也会制造必须 answer 的探草需求

route_gates.condition: 烧草、破草或显形会直接降低敌方绕后价值
route_gates.payoff: 降低敌方倒计时伏击和侧路包夹
route_gates.bp_use: 可作为保护中路核心的反 flank 选择

hard_gates.requirement: provide mine control, carrier safety, carrier punish, or a named support plan for those jobs

false_positive_filters.reason: 必须优先确认队伍是否有探草/扫草；没有视野时长手价值降级
适合中后手补侧路压力，也会制造必须 answer 的探草需求
可作为保护中路核心的反 flank 选择

false_positive_filters.if: 我方没有可靠探草或扫草
false_positive_filters.then: 不要把纯长手当作稳定先手
false_positive_filters.because: 侧路草带会让远程视野被反复压缩
false_positive_filters.bp_use: 优先补 vision / sweep / spread control

false_positive_filters.if: 敌方拿到 gem lead 并准备倒计时撤退
false_positive_filters.then: 侧路 flank 和显形能力升值
false_positive_filters.because: 倒计时时宝石持有者常借草丛撤退
false_positive_filters.bp_use: 后手可用探草、拉人或绕后制造翻盘窗口

false_positive_filters.if: 敌方依赖草丛坦克或刺客
false_positive_filters.then: 破草/烧草可以成为 ban/pick 依据
false_positive_filters.because: 地形一旦被否定，敌方接近路线成本上升

false_positive_filters.note: 只写“草多所以坦克强”不够；高水平对局会持续探草，坦克需要路线、队友压制或视野资源。
纯投掷若没有队友保护，容易被侧路草丛压死。

poison_vision_and_carrier_retreat_tax.objective_conversion: protect gem carrier retreat, reveal flank pressure, and stop hidden enemies from healing before a countdown or zone fight
poison_vision_and_carrier_retreat_tax.active_when: map rewards bush scouting and Crow can tag enemies without overcommitting into thrower or sniper range
poison_vision_and_carrier_retreat_tax.fails_if: grass is burned, walls block repeated tags, or enemy outranges Crow on the route

anti_heal_slow_zone_entry.objective_conversion: delay zone re-entry, reduce tank damage during a push, or create a teammate finish window on slowed targets
anti_heal_slow_zone_entry.active_when: enemy plan needs healing, grouped entry, or close-range bodies to walk through a predictable lane, and allies can convert within the 3-tick poison / 4-second anti-heal window
anti_heal_slow_zone_entry.fails_if: enemy controls from behind a wall, spreads across lanes, or Crow is forced to stand on zone as the main body

jump_score_or_cleanup_window.objective_conversion: turn chip damage into a kill, retrieve a self-pass, or bypass a short defender for a score attempt
jump_score_or_cleanup_window.active_when: target is below half, slowed, or isolated and Crow still has enough health or shield to survive landing
jump_score_or_cleanup_window.fails_if: enemy holds knockback/burst, target is behind multiple teammates, or goal geometry remains closed

heist_lane_attrition_not_primary_dps.objective_conversion: convert lane chip into safe access for a DPS teammate or deny enemy short-range safe entry
heist_lane_attrition_not_primary_dps.active_when: team already has safe DPS and Crow's job is lane control, anti-heal, and anti-aggro defense
heist_lane_attrition_not_primary_dps.fails_if: draft expects Crow to be the main safe damage source or enemy wins with longer range/cross-lane DPS

needs_teammate_support: durable carrier or mid control teammate
wallbreak/thrower answer if enemies hide behind pockets
objective_contracts.false_positive: Poison can reveal and delay, but Crow's low health makes him a poor solo carrier when the enemy has long-range focus.

needs_teammate_support: peel after Crow spends Super aggressively
objective_contracts.false_positive: Crow can create or finish a score window; he does not solve closed goals or front-line holding by himself.

needs_teammate_support: lane winner that converts poisoned defenders into safe hits
objective_contracts.false_positive: Heist Crow is a control/defense layer; drafting him as the sole race tool is a trap.

needs_teammate_support: area clear or wallbreak against pocket control
objective_contracts.false_positive: Crow helps win the edge of the zone; he still needs teammates to occupy and clear the circle.

needs_teammate_support: teammate to hold star lead and convert poisoned targets
long-range or wallbreak answer if enemy has snipers or wall pockets
objective_contracts.false_positive: Poison tags and reveal can farm low-risk stars, but Crow's 5600 HP and low burst make him a poor star holder when enemies outrange him on open maps like Dry Season.

needs_teammate_support: teammate burst or control to bring targets into Crow's cleanup window
anti-aggro peel if enemy divers can bypass poison range
objective_contracts.false_positive: Crow can punish slowed or chipped targets, but Knockout deaths are permanent and his low health means a blind dive or open-lane trade against Belle's Rock snipers is a trap.

low_health_pressure.active_when: enemy can force close-range contact before Crow has Super, Gadget, or teammate peel
low_health_pressure.mitigation: play at max tag range, pair with anti-aggro teammate, or choose Slowing Toxin/Extra Toxic

outranged_open_map.active_when: enemy snipers or high-damage long-range picks hold open lanes and Crow cannot safely apply poison
outranged_open_map.mitigation: draft Crow on bush/route maps or after bans remove long-lane punishers

chip_without_objective_conversion.active_when: Crow repeatedly poisons targets but team lacks a scorer, safe DPS, zone body, or finisher
chip_without_objective_conversion.mitigation: pair with burst, carrier, frontliner, or safe DPS depending on mode

spawnable_or_wall_pocket_tax.active_when: enemy spawnables, porters, turrets, or thrower pockets absorb Crow's low damage and block priority tags
spawnable_or_wall_pocket_tax.mitigation: add wallbreak, splash, or a teammate that clears bodies before relying on poison pressure

slot_notes.slot_1: acceptable only when map rewards poison vision/anti-heal and bans protect him from long-range or hard dive punishment.
slot_notes.slot_2_3: good into early sustain, tank, or bush-control plans if the team already has objective conversion.
slot_notes.slot_4_5: use to add anti-heal, reveal, and slow after seeing enemy front line, while keeping a final slot for body or damage.
slot_notes.slot_6: punishes drafts that lack long-range answer, cleanse, spawnable tax, or a way to stop a slowed low-health cleanup jump.

Knockout deaths are permanent and Bruce can be burst down before value; if the enemy has splash/thrower/chain clear, Nita's Super feeds a pick instead of creating a catch window, so she is a late situational pick, not an open-map staple.

field_promotion_knockout_or_slow_mode_va.bp_use: Knockout/Bounty 慢节奏且不缺开墙时的 build requirement

mitigates_failure_modes: Ruffs 主攻击无法直接命中墙后或角落目标

bounce_wall_corridor_pressure.fails_if: 地图被开成纯长线、敌方有稳定投掷/弹墙反制，或 Ruffs 需要站到危险角度才有线

supply_drop_buff_long_lane_core.objective_conversion: Bounty/Knockout 保星、长线对枪、回合领先后撤退

supply_drop_buff_long_lane_core.fails_if: 队友拿不到补给、死亡会丢 buff，或敌方用投掷/刺客直接越过沙包打 Ruffs

air_superiority_goal_or_pocket_wallbreak.objective_conversion: Brawl Ball 破门、反投掷、打开长线或清除守点掩体
air_superiority_goal_or_pocket_wallbreak.active_when: 某一面墙保护敌方门前、投掷或中心口袋，开墙后我方远程/得分手更受益
air_superiority_goal_or_pocket_wallbreak.fails_if: 开墙帮助敌方远程接管，或我方阵容本身依赖这面墙生存

heist_buffed_lane_and_safe_support.objective_conversion: 提高 lane race、保住弱侧、延长己方 DPS 对 safe 的输出时间
heist_buffed_lane_and_safe_support.active_when: 我方已有主 safe DPS，Ruffs 负责 buff、弹墙支援和开墙/驱赶
heist_buffed_lane_and_safe_support.fails_if: 队伍缺主 DPS，或 Ruffs 被要求单独赢 isolated Heist lane

objective_contracts.false_positive: Ruffs 自己低血，补给包价值必须转给能赢线的队友
开门只在我方有得分后续时有价值，否则可能帮敌方远程
PLP 全模式适配不能理解为无条件强；Ruffs 必须有队友把 buff 转成目标收益
Ruffs 的补给和弹墙支援只在队友能吃到 buff 并转成矿区控制时才有价值；Hard Rock Mine/Gem Fort 的草丛和投掷会绕过沙包
Bridge Too Far/Kaboom Canyon/Hot Potato 中 Ruffs 是 buff + 开墙支援，不是单独 race；把他当主 safe DPS 是陷阱
Ruffs 低血，补给包价值必须转给能赢星差的队友；Shooting Star/Dry Season 纯开阔镜像里他不是独立长线 pick
Ruffs 能在 Dueling Beetles/Open Business/Parallel Plays 边线 buff 和开墙，但低血让他无法站圈，zone time 必须由队友提供
Field Promotion 和补给在慢节奏 Knockout 有生存价值，但 Belle's Rock/Flaring Phoenix 的多角度突进和投掷会绕过沙包压低血 Ruffs

low_health_and_sandbag_bypass.active_when: 敌方有投掷、穿透、弹墙、召唤物或强突进能绕过 Take Cover
low_health_and_sandbag_bypass.mitigation: 使用距离、墙角、队友 peel 或改成开墙/反投掷计划

buff_without_conversion.active_when: 队友无法安全拾取补给，或拾取后不能转成线权/目标输出
buff_without_conversion.mitigation: 优先搭配长线核心、safe DPS、站圈身体或高价值 carrier

terrain_transform_backfires.active_when: Air Superiority 开墙后敌方远程/突进比我方更受益
terrain_transform_backfires.mitigation: 只开关键墙，或在 draft 中确认我方有开墙后的远程/得分后续

support_tempo_too_slow.active_when: 快节奏进球、站圈或 safe race 不给 Ruffs 连续发包/站位时间
support_tempo_too_slow.mitigation: 选择即时开墙/沙包价值，或避免把 Ruffs 当作唯一节奏来源

hypercharge_transfer_not_baseline.active_when: 阵容把“补给包充满队友 Hypercharge”当作每次 Super 都有的稳定团队循环
hypercharge_transfer_not_baseline.mitigation: 把普通补给只按伤害/最大生命增益结算；只有明确追踪到 Ruffs Hypercharge 时才预算一次队友 Hypercharge 转移

slot_notes.slot_1: 可以在队友/地图职责明确会用到 buff、开墙或弹墙支援时先手；不要在缺目标核心时裸选。
slot_notes.slot_2_3: 适合作为回答 sniper-heavy、门墙/投掷口袋或需要团队强化的成组 pick。
slot_notes.slot_4_5: 用来补开墙、保护己方核心或给前两手加成，但必须避免被敌方 6 位投掷/刺客一手拆掉低血支援。
slot_notes.slot_6: 敌方缺投掷、缺穿透且已经暴露固定长线/墙角对位时，Ruffs 可作为高质量支援惩罚。

multiball_launcher_super_bouncy_shield_d.build: Multiball Launcher / Super Bouncy / Shield, Damage

bouncy_castle_robo_retreat_control_or_es.build: Bouncy Castle / Robo Retreat control-or-escape variant

safe_or_objective_bounce_angle.objective_conversion: Heist chip, zone denial, or forcing defenders off objective

safe_or_objective_bounce_angle.fails_if: objective is fully open with no bounce value or enemy wallbreak removes angle

Heist label is weak if Rico cannot reach safe from a bounce route
Closed-map value flips if enemy has easy wallbreak or deeper thrower pocket

wallbreak_erases_plan.active_when: enemy or teammate opens the specific walls Rico needs for lane control
wallbreak_erases_plan.mitigation: protect walls, ban/answer wallbreak, or choose non-wall-dependent DPS

thrower_or_deeper_pocket_outcontrols.active_when: enemy thrower controls Rico's bounce position from a safer wall pocket
thrower_or_deeper_pocket_outcontrols.mitigation: pair wallbreak or dive, avoid picking Rico into uncontested thrower pockets

vending_machine_cleared_before_conversio.active_when: 敌方能用投掷、穿透或大范围火力从安全角度清掉贩卖机，或 Rico 无法向它反弹加载
vending_machine_cleared_before_conversio.mitigation: 放到敌方必须转线才能清的位置，或在清点资源交掉后再部署

low_health_dive_in_open_angle.active_when: assassin reaches Rico outside a corridor before vending cover, Bouncy slow, or bounce pressure converts

slot_notes.slot_1: 只在耐久反弹路线很明确，或贩卖机有受保护的目标锚点时先手；仍要预留对投掷、穿透清点和选择性开墙的回答。
slot_notes.slot_2_3: 可围绕耐久墙廊建立反弹核心，或用贩卖机补一个临时掩体/反弹面；需要队友保留关键墙体。
slot_notes.slot_4_5: 用于补 Brawl Ball/Gem/Knockout 的封路、临时掩体或分裂减速；先检查敌方是否已有穿透/投掷清贩卖机资源。
slot_notes.slot_6: 当敌方缺开墙、缺安全清贩卖机手段，且必须经过墙边或窄口时，Rico 是高收益惩罚位。

sneaky_sneakers_super_charged_shield_dam.build: Sneaky Sneakers / Super Charged / Shield, Damage

phase_shifter_run_n_gun_mobility_variant.build: Phase Shifter / Run n' Gun mobility variant

open_lane_dodge_pressure.fails_if: enemy uses unavoidable area control, traps, slows, hard CC, or wall/water geometry truncates the dash

speed_enabled_scoring_or_chase_window.objective_conversion: score attempt, gem carrier chase, or collapse on exposed backline

objective_contracts.false_positive: Speed/return heal only helps if the carrier already has a safe route and can regroup near an uncontested anchor
Fast team movement does not equal scoring if goal geometry is closed
Max can survive long lanes but may not create stars without a finisher
If gas closes into hard control, Max speed may only delay the loss
Max's objective damage is lane pressure, not safe race; on Hot Potato / Pit Stop / Safe Zone she only helps a real safe DPS deliver damage and cannot convert tempo into vault HP by herself

Max speed and return heal help a team that already has a zone body; on Dueling Beetles / Ring of Fire / Open Business she cannot stand zone or clear it alone, so speed without a body just rotates without scoring

speed_without_conversion.active_when: team has no scorer, finisher, tank, or burst follow-up to exploit Max Super

return_or_dash_anchor_punished.active_when: Sneaky Sneakers marker is camped, Phase Shifter endpoint is blocked by terrain/control, or Max dies before the three-second return
return_or_dash_anchor_punished.mitigation: place return marker away from bushes/spawn or prefer Phase Shifter

hyper_resource_requires_close_hits.mitigation: 只在可安全结阵且 Max 有稳定命中窗口时计入，不把它当常驻团队资源

low_pick_pressure_on_pure_long_range.active_when: Max can dodge but cannot threaten kills into true snipers or throwers
low_pick_pressure_on_pure_long_range.mitigation: add long-range finisher, pull, or wallbreak teammate

slot_notes.slot_1: 可在队伍有明确速度/护盾转化者时先手；要接受敌方用硬控、投掷或抱团惩罚回答。
